title: Associate, Specialist, Operations, Project Management, Corporate Banking, Technology and Operations
description:
**Business Function:**
Group Technology and Operations (T&O) enables and empowers the bank with an efficient, nimble and resilient infrastructure through a strategic focus on productivity, quality & control, technology, people capability and innovation. In Group T&O, we manage the majority of the Bank's operational processes and inspire to delight our business partners through our multiple banking delivery channels.
  
  
**Key Requirements**
**Key Accountabilities:**

* Possess analytical skill to analyse trends in CBG and IBG operations
* Understand of Ops products
* Should be able to build dashboard on Tableau based on data dump
* Work with large datasets, distributed Big Data Platforms for a variety of advanced analytics solutions across the bank ranging from recommendation engines, propensity models, customer segmentation, Graph models
* Engage with business and product teams to formulate problems and create solution framework
* End-to-End execution from data collection, analysis, feature engineering, model development, implementation (including testing) and monitoring
* Drive the testing and deployment of the machine learning products into production
* Excellent pattern recognition and predictive modelling skills
* Understand the Product Journeys and help business to improve the customer experience
* Drive insight led actionable to help achieve business targets
* Support business in meeting the Budgets through Analytical Insights; support stakeholders in Business Reviews
* Ability to create high quality documentation such as process maps & project plans
* Ability to work collaboratively with diverse stake-holder and obtain their agreement on any enhancements / gaps identified
* Ability to manage multiple projects across Operations team
* Prepare and deliver training materials for the project, provide training to the operation staffs to ensure proper knowledge transfer.

**Experience:**

* 5-7 years of post-qualification experience in related field. Worked in Performance & business monitoring functions.
* Understanding of relevant banking and financial services processes, services, ecosystems and regulations.

**Personal Attributes:**

* Ability to effectively communicate at all levels within an organization
* Good written and oral communication.
* High level of problem-solving aptitude and demonstrated organizational skills.

**Education / Preferred Qualifications:**

* An MBA or Chartered Accountant or equivalent degree is preferable

**Core Competencies:**

* Good problem solving/analytical, planning & organising skills. Planning, scheduling and monitoring deliverables, within a stipulated time frame using effective methods
* Good interpersonal and communications skills

**Work Relationship:**
Possess good working relationship and a high degree of team spirit and cooperation with relationship group as well as service partners in the bank such as Operations, Finance, Legal etc, so as to ensure seamless delivery of projects
  
  
**Location:**
I-Think Techno, Kanjurmarg
  
  
**Job:**
Operations
  
  
**Schedule:**
Regular
  
  
**Employee Status:**
Full time

title: Engineer - R&D
description:
**What makes us strong?**
Our employees in 50 countries worldwide – all working with passion to enable high-tech applications with our strong metals: tungsten and molybdenum.
  
  
Our CERATIZIT sites in India are key production and sales locations — offering precision tools and services for the automotive, aerospace, electronics and engineering sectors, with a strong focus on innovation and sustainability.
  
  
Join a highly motivated team in India, where local expertise meets the global knowledge and values of the Plansee Group.
  
  
**Tasks & Responsibilities**

* To provide support in developing SPECIAL TOOLS as per application requirement
* Thorough understanding of application requirement, detail techno-commercial evaluation, assessing thoroughly viability of development of special projects
* Hands on experience on CNC Machines, & Complete Project execution as per the commitment
* To explore and develop suitable Vendor in coordination with Vendor Development Cell for various of critical products and processing.
* Sound knowledge on Cutting tools trouble shooting.
* To act as the nodal coordinator in development process of special tools as per application requirement
* To coordinate with stakeholders in back-office teams in Design, Project and Production for finalizing solutions or proposing new products
* To build technical competence amongst the Sales and Production Team though required training, webinar and seminars both in customer premises and online medium.

**Profile & Requirements**

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical/Production Engineering with 3-5 years of experience in cutting tool design and development.
* Strong knowledge of special cutting tools, machining processes, and tool geometry.
* Hands-on experience with CNC machines and machining applications.
* Proficiency in CAD software such as Creo, SolidWorks, or AutoCAD.
* Experience in special tool development, feasibility studies, and project execution.
* Good understanding of cutting tool troubleshooting and performance optimization.
* Ability to collaborate with Design, Production, Application, Sales, and Vendor teams for new product development and customer solutions.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work with advanced CNC cutting tool manufacturing technologies.
* Exposure to international quality standards and world-class manufacturing practices.
* Attractive compensation and benefits package based on experience and qualifications.
* Long-term growth opportunities within a technology-driven manufacturing organization.

title: Fresher Academic content writer
description:
**Company Description**
Shikshit Educare is a dynamic educational platform that connects students with experienced mentors and teachers to provide focused academic guidance. The organization supports both academic growth and self-development by offering structured learning support and skill-building opportunities. Through personalized mentoring, Shikshit Educare helps learners strengthen subject knowledge and develop effective study habits. The platform is committed to creating a supportive environment where students receive practical, high-quality educational resources and direction.
  
**Role Description**
The Academic Content Writer will create clear, accurate, and engaging academic materials, including lesson content, study notes, assessments, and online resources aligned with curriculum requirements. Day-to-day responsibilities include researching subject topics, organizing information, and writing content that supports students’ understanding and skill development. The role also involves revising and proofreading content for clarity, consistency, and correctness, and collaborating with mentors and teachers to ensure materials meet learning objectives. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bara Nagar, requiring regular presence to coordinate with the academic team and contribute to ongoing content projects.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Writing and Web Content Writing skills for creating structured, student-focused academic materials.
* Candidates should possess Research and Content Strategy skills to develop relevant, curriculum-aligned topics and organized learning paths.
* Candidates should possess solid Proofreading skills to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality of all academic content.
* Candidates should demonstrate excellent command of written English, including grammar, tone, and formatting appropriate for educational content.
* Candidates should have strong attention to detail, time management skills, and the ability to handle multiple content projects simultaneously.
* A bachelor’s degree in Education, English, or a relevant academic discipline is preferred, along with prior experience in academic or educational content writing.
* Familiarity with school or college-level curricula and basic digital tools (word processing, online collaboration platforms) will be beneficial.

title: Manager Business Consulting - IT
description:
It's about Being What's next.
**What's in it for you?**
The Manager Business Consulting will act as a business-facing IT partner by managing the application lifecycle and providing effective post-implementation support for Sales and Supply processes across the RSE region
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
  
  
Every day is an opportunity: an opportunity to learn, to grow, to share success, and to contribute to one of the world’s leading industrial gas and engineering companies. Seize the opportunity: take your next step with us and join our team.
  
  
Linde values diversity and recognizes the importance of fostering inclusion in our work environment. We believe that our success depends on the diverse perspectives of our employees, customers, and global markets. As an employer of choice, we strive to support our employees' growth, welcome new ideas, and respect our differences.
  
  
Team
  
  

Making an impact.
**What will you do?**

* In this role you will participate as a core project team member in the implementation of SAP and non-SAP applications, including system interfaces, across the RSE region
* Further you will own the application development lifecycle for assigned initiatives by working with business users to gather and document requirements, translating them into SAP process designs, developing the functional specifications, configuring SAP solutions, collaborating closely with ABAP developers for custom developments, performing system testing, supporting user acceptance test and ensuring successful deployment.
* Furthermore, you will identify process gaps and propose workarounds where required
* Moreover, you will provide end-to-end SAP application support for Sales and Supply systems across the relevant modules (e.g. SD, MM/PP/PM, Procurement, SAP authorisations, integrated FI/CO areas), including issue troubleshooting, user training, data cleansing and post go-live support
* Further you will maintain accurate and up-to-date system documentation, including business requirements, solution designs, configuration details and user/training manuals
* Moreover, you will act as a business process specialist by maintaining a strong understanding of Sales and Supply processes including OTC, PTP, R2R and master data management
* Additionally, you will collaborate with Global IT teams (including GIMS, BASIS, Release Management, TCOE, Global Business Consulting), Shared Services, regional and country IT teams, and external vendors to ensure successful project delivery and support

Winning in your role.
**Do you have what it takes?**

* For this role you will have a degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or other disciplines with strong interest in business consulting and a solid understanding of IT and business applications
* Further you have a minimum of 3 years’ experience in system implementations, particularly in SAP SD
* Furthermore, you have a strong business knowledge and understanding of Sales and Supply processes
* Additionally, you have the ability to work in a global environment and travel as required

**Why you will love working for us!**
Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company, operating in more than 100 countries worldwide. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain and protect our planet.
  
  
On the 1st of April 2020, Linde India Limited and Praxair India Private Limited successfully formed a joint venture, LSAS Services Private Limited. This company will provide Operations and Management (O&M) services to both existing organizations, which will continue to operate separately. LSAS carries forward the commitment towards sustainable development, championed by both legacy organizations. It also takes ahead the tradition of the development of processes and technologies that have revolutionized the industrial gases industry, serving a variety of end markets including chemicals & refining, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, and primary metals.
  
  
At Linde, the sky is not the limit. If you’re looking to build a career where your work reaches beyond your job description and betters the people with whom you work, the communities we serve, and the world in which we all live, at Linde, your opportunities are limitless. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
  
  
Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!
  
  
We are looking forward to receiving your complete application (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online job market.
  
  
Any designations used of course apply to persons of all genders. The form of speech used here is for simplicity only.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.
  
  
Linde South Asia Services Pvt. Ltd. acts responsibly towards its shareholders, business partners, employees, society and the environment in every one of its business areas, regions and locations across the globe. The company is committed to technologies and products that unite the goals of customer value and sustainable development.
